title: Template:Unsigned/doc
content: ;Description :This is for use when users do not sign their posts in talk pages. ;Syntax :Type {{t|unsigned|username}} where "username" is the name of the user who did not sign their post. You can also add the current date via a third parameter. ;Sample output :{{unsigned|Default}} gives... :{{unsigned|Default}} :{{unsigned|Default|~~~~~}} gives... :{{unsigned|Default|12:01, 01 January 2010 (UTC)}} [[Category:General wiki templates|{{PAGENAME}}]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
